emails.subject: people-ops-planning@ — group membership confirmed
emails.body:
Hi Priya,

Quick admin note — IT finished setting up the people-ops-planning@northwind-health.com distribution list you asked for. Current members (5):

  • Priya Shah (you) — People Ops Lead
  • Marcus Chen — Senior People Ops Manager
  • Dana Ortiz — Wellbeing Program Designer
  • Aisha Rahman — Senior Recruiter (cross-functional partner, not in today's planning meeting)

Anything sent to that address will go to all five of us. Let me know if you want to add or remove anyone.

— Tomas

emails.subject: Loop me in on wellbeing launch comms
emails.body:
Hey Priya,

When you and Marcus land on the employee-facing launch timeline for the wellbeing program, can you loop me in? There's some overlap with the candidate-experience messaging I'm rolling out in Q3 and I want to make sure we're not stepping on each other.

No rush — happy to coordinate after your planning sync this week.

— Aisha
